data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 3.5m was experienced in 2018 (2017: GBP 18.1m surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 1.7m on direct business (2017: GBP 22.5m surplus) and a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance accepted business (2017: GBP 4.4m deficit).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 3.5 million in 2018. This favorable development was explicitly described as a 'surplus run-off amount' and comprised a GBP 1.7 million surplus on prior year claims provisions for direct business and a GBP 1.8 million surplus on reinsurance accepted business. The overall direction of prior year development was a release, indicating that reserves held at the beginning of the year were more than adequate.
